points.K7: 电流型：正常时进出相等
points.K8: 电流型：漏电时不再相等
points.K9: 电流型：检出差值就跳闸
points.K11: 区别二：电压型与电流型

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，白板上画着两个空白模块，中间写着对比符号
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a whiteboard showing two blank breaker modules with a versus symbol between them.
shots.narration: 这一课比较两种漏电断路器。

shots.scene: 齿轮和天平两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons in a row: a gear and a pair of balance scales. No people.
shots.narration: 它们怎么工作，又有什么区别。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着两个外观相似的空白模块，左看右看
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds two similar blank breaker modules, one in each hand, looking back and forth.
shots.narration: 阿杰拿着两个模块，分不清。

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，头顶冒出问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head with a question mark bubble above him.
shots.narration: 名字不同，样子却差不多。

shots.scene: 欣欣在白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of the whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 来，一次讲明白。

shots.scene: 两个外观相似的空白模块并排，中间有问号
shots.prompt_en: Two similar blank breaker modules side by side with a big question mark between them. No people.
shots.narration: 说到电气，这两个名字最容易混。

shots.scene: 第一个模块下方有接地符号和漏电小箭头
shots.prompt_en: A blank breaker module with a ground symbol and a small leaking arrow beneath it. No people.
shots.narration: ELCB，接地漏电断路器。

shots.scene: 第二个模块下方有两个电流箭头和差值符号
shots.prompt_en: A blank breaker module with two opposite current arrows and a small difference symbol beneath it. No people.
shots.narration: RCCB，剩余电流断路器。

shots.scene: 旧模块被放进回收箱，新模块装上导轨
shots.prompt_en: An old style blank breaker module goes into a recycling bin while a new blank module clicks onto a mounting rail. No people.
shots.narration: RCCB更新，已基本取代旧式ELCB。

shots.scene: 简化示意：进线两根、出线两根，旁边一个感测块
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram: two incoming wires at the top, two outgoing wires at the bottom, a blue sensing block on the side. No people.
shots.narration: 先看电压型ELCB的结构。

shots.scene: 进线和出线的放大
shots.prompt_en: A close view of the diagram: a red and a black incoming wire, a red and a black outgoing wire. No people.
shots.narration: 进线、出线都是相线和中性线。

shots.scene: 感测块一端用绿黄线连到设备金属外壳
shots.prompt_en: From the sensing block a green and yellow wire runs to the metal case of a machine. No people.
shots.narration: 感测块一端接地线，来自设备外壳。

shots.scene: 相线碰到设备金属外壳，闪出火花
shots.prompt_en: In the diagram, a live wire touches the inside of the metal machine case with a small spark. No people.
shots.narration: 相线意外碰到金属外壳，

shots.scene: 电流沿接地线流过感测块，感测块发亮
shots.prompt_en: Glowing dots flow from the case down the ground wire through the sensing block, which lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 故障电流沿地线流过感测线圈。

shots.scene: 感测块上出现电压表图标
shots.prompt_en: A voltmeter icon appears on the glowing sensing block. No people.
shots.narration: 产生的电压，足以让脱扣动作。

shots.scene: 开关断开，设备灯灭
shots.prompt_en: The switch contacts open and the machine goes dark, separated from the power source. No people.
shots.narration: 断路器断开，负载与电源隔离。

shots.scene: 一个圆环，相线和中性线一起从中间穿过
shots.prompt_en: A ring shaped core with a red wire and a black wire passing together through its center. No people.
shots.narration: RCCB靠零序电流互感器工作。

shots.scene: 示意图：试验按钮、触头、继电器、负载
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram with a test button, breaker contacts, the ring core, a relay coil and a load lamp. No people.
shots.narration: 还有触头、试验按钮和继电器。

shots.section_title: 电流型：正常时进出相等
shots.scene: 红线上向负载的箭头，黑线上流回的箭头
shots.prompt_en: On the red wire an arrow points toward the load, on the black wire an arrow points back. No people.
shots.narration: 它一直比较相线和中性线的电流。
overlay: 电流型：正常时进出相等

shots.section_title: 电流型：正常时进出相等
shots.scene: 两根线旁各有一个相同的电流表
shots.prompt_en: Two identical ammeter icons, one beside each wire, needles at the same position. No people.
shots.narration: 比如相线送出20安，

shots.section_title: 电流型：正常时进出相等
shots.scene: 中性线电流表同样读数
shots.prompt_en: The ammeter on the black wire shows the same needle position as the red one. No people.
shots.narration: 中性线也流回20安。

shots.section_title: 电流型：正常时进出相等
shots.scene: 天平两端相等，圆环旁标零
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale perfectly level next to the ring core with a zero icon. No people.
shots.narration: 互感器里抵消为零，不动作。

shots.section_title: 电流型：漏电时不再相等
shots.scene: 一只手形图标碰到红线，一股小箭头经身体流向地面
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand touching the red wire, with a small arrow running through a body pictogram down to the ground. No people.
shots.narration: 有人碰到相线，或接地故障时，
overlay: 电流型：漏电时不再相等

shots.section_title: 电流型：漏电时不再相等
shots.scene: 红线箭头变长
shots.prompt_en: The arrow on the red wire grows longer while the black wire arrow stays the same. No people.
shots.narration: 相线是20安加30毫安漏电，

shots.section_title: 电流型：漏电时不再相等
shots.scene: 黑线箭头仍为原长
shots.prompt_en: The black wire arrow remains at its original length, highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 中性线却还是20安。

shots.section_title: 电流型：漏电时不再相等
shots.scene: 天平向一侧倾斜
shots.prompt_en: The balance scale tips to one side next to the ring core. No people.
shots.narration: 两边不再相等。

shots.section_title: 电流型：检出差值就跳闸
shots.scene: 圆环发亮，感测线圈发出信号
shots.prompt_en: The ring core glows and a small sensing coil around it sends a signal spark. No people.
shots.narration: 这30毫安的差值被互感器检出，
overlay: 电流型：检出差值就跳闸

shots.section_title: 电流型：检出差值就跳闸
shots.scene: 信号传到继电器，开关拨下
shots.prompt_en: The signal travels to a small relay coil, which flips the breaker lever down to off. No people.
shots.narration: 送到继电器线圈，RCCB跳闸。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在左右两栏的空白板前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank board divided into left and right columns.
shots.narration: 最后看两者的区别。

shots.scene: 第二个模块旁又贴了一张空白标签
shots.prompt_en: The second blank breaker module gets an extra blank name tag attached to it. No people.
shots.narration: RCCB也叫RCD，剩余电流装置。

shots.section_title: 区别二：电压型与电流型
shots.scene: 左栏电压表图标，右栏电流表图标
shots.prompt_en: On the left a voltmeter icon, on the right an ammeter icon, separated by a line. No people.
shots.narration: ELCB是电压型，叫VOELCB。
overlay: 区别二：电压型与电流型

shots.section_title: 区别二：电压型与电流型
shots.scene: 右栏电流表指针摆动
shots.prompt_en: The ammeter icon needle swings on the right side. No people.
shots.narration: RCCB是电流型。

shots.scene: 左栏接地线完好，模块打勾
shots.prompt_en: On the left, the old module has an intact ground wire and a green check. No people.
shots.narration: ELCB要有良好的接地连接，

shots.scene: 左栏接地线断开，模块打问号
shots.prompt_en: On the left, the ground wire of the old module is broken, and the module shows a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 才能正常工作。

shots.scene: 右栏模块没有接地线，仍打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: On the right, the new module without any ground wire still shows a green check. No people.
shots.narration: RCCB不需要接地连接也能工作。

shots.scene: 左栏漏电绕过接地线，从别处流走，模块未动作
shots.prompt_en: On the left, leakage current flows to ground through another path, bypassing the ground wire, the old module stays on. No people.
shots.narration: ELCB：漏电不走它的地线就不跳。

shots.scene: 右栏漏电经人体流向大地，模块跳闸
shots.prompt_en: On the right, leakage current flows through a body pictogram to the ground and the new module trips off. No people.
shots.narration: RCCB：漏电经大地流走就会跳。

shots.scene: 老式模块挂上淘汰标签
shots.prompt_en: The old style blank module gets a gray outdated tag and fades out. No people.
shots.narration: 电压型ELCB已经被淘汰。

shots.scene: 新模块上贴着两个名字的空白标签
shots.prompt_en: One new blank breaker module with two blank name tags attached to it. No people.
shots.narration: 现在叫ELCB的，多半就是电流型。

shots.scene: 欣欣点头指着新模块
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods and points at the new breaker module.
shots.narration: 原理一样，所以两个名字常混用。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现两个模块图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside two floating blank breaker module icons.
shots.narration: 电压型靠地线，电流型比进出。

shots.scene: 天平倾斜，开关跳下
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a tipped balance scale and a breaker lever dropping to off. No people.
shots.narration: 相线中性线不等，就跳闸。

shots.scene: 旧模块淡出，新模块发亮
shots.prompt_en: An old module fading out next to a bright new module. No people.
shots.narration: 如今用的，基本都是电流型。

shots.scene: 欣欣在白板前挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera in front of the whiteboard with two module drawings.
shots.narration: 弄清两种保护器，下次见！
